title: OnlyIdeas
shortDescription: Find research papers, read in flowing text, translate and discuss ideas.
fullDescription:
Find a paper, read it comfortably, and keep the questions it raises in one place. OnlyIdeas brings paper search, a research assistant, translations and discussion into your reading library.

FIND AND OPEN RESEARCH
Search by title, DOI, author or topic. OnlyIdeas checks papers already in the library before looking online. Open an existing public transcript immediately, or request an accessible full-text source. If an automatic download fails, attach your own authorized PDF to the paper.

READ WITHOUT PINCHING EVERY LINE
Turn supported PDFs and accessible article pages into flowing text with equations, figures and tables. Import PDF, image, Word, Markdown or text files. Adjust text size and appearance, keep your place, and save processed papers for offline reading. Conversion quality depends on the source; the original link stays available for checking.

KEEP LANGUAGES TOGETHER
Request a translation of a paper or a smaller passage. Read the original, the translation, or both interlaced. Existing compatible public transcripts and translations are reused. AI translations and reading guides are labeled and may contain errors.

CONTINUE THE CONVERSATION
Ask the research assistant to find a paper, add it to your library or explain a passage. Return to saved conversations, attach files, and follow the progress of imports. Mention up to three saved papers with @, or quote a message to keep a follow-up question focused. Saved transcripts are reused. Private files and chats stay in your account.

BUILD YOUR READING SPACE
Save and like papers, browse your activity, and choose topics for your research recommendations. Skip the first-use choice or update your interests later. Reopen with saved suggestions, refresh for newer papers, and load more as you browse. Recent suggestions stay available offline. Discuss a paper or a selected passage. Shared papers are available to other readers; personal notes and conversations are private.

CHOOSE WHAT TO SHARE
Choose Shared or Only me when adding material. To publish immediately, confirm that you have permission and select a suitable license; administrator review follows publication. Unconfirmed sharing requests wait for review. Permissions are remembered for the same material and account, and retries keep the original choice. Share public papers through the device share sheet or WeChat, or copy a reading or research draft for EchoMind and AiMemo. Public content can be reported and readers can be blocked. Share only material you have the right to publish, including its figures.

ACCOUNT AND USAGE
Browse public papers without signing in. Sign in to import, use the assistant and join discussions. Profile provides account controls and deletion. Processing and AI requests have limits; the app shows available allowances and any required credit confirmation before an import. Existing papers and cached translations remain free to read. OnlyIdeas credits belong to this app, are non-transferable and have no cash value.
